headline: Canva Announces Major Workforce Reductions Amid Difficult Market Conditions
summary: Design software company Canva announced plans to cut over 1,000 staff positions or require role changes following what CEO Melanie Perkins described as its hardest year yet.
why: Workforce reductions at major private technology companies can signal shifting sector valuations, broader macroeconomic pressures, and changing demand dynamics within the software-as-a-service industry.
